Policy Name: Cigna Lumbar Fusion (CMM-609: Lumbar Fusion with Decompression)
Referred Sections: CMM-609.1: General Guidelines > Application of Guideline

Required findings: Traumatic spinal fractures or dislocations (with or without neural compression) when instability is present or decompression of the spinal canal is anticipated to result in iatrogenic instability
Infection (e.g., discitis, epidural abscess, osteomyelitis) when instability is present or debridement and/or decompression is anticipated to result in iatrogenic instability

Primary or metastatic neoplastic disease causing pathologic fracture, cord compression, when instability is present, or resection and/or decompression is anticipated to result in iatrogenic instability
A condition otherwise meeting criteria listed in the applicable procedure section(s) with documentation of severe debilitating pain and/or dysfunction to the point of being incapacitated
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-609.1: General Guidelines > Urgent/Emergent Indications/Conditions (TOC: S4.3.2)

Non-Indications: Cases where the determination of medical necessity is not made on a case-by-case basis
Urgent/emergent conditions lacking required imaging findings noted in the applicable procedure section(s)
Non-urgent cases where provider-directed non-surgical management has not been attempted or documented
Non-urgent cases where proof of smoking cessation is not provided
Non-urgent cases with unmanaged significant mental and/or behavioral health disorders (e.g., major depressive disorder, chronic pain syndrome, secondary gain, opioid and alcohol use disorders)
Repeat procedures performed outside the required time frame for non-urgent cases
Important criteria & exceptions: The determination of medical necessity for the performance of lumbar fusion (with or without osteotomy) is always made on a case-by-case basis

For urgent/emergent conditions, the following criteria are NOT required: provider-directed non-surgical management, proof of smoking cessation, absence of unmanaged significant mental and/or behavioral health disorders, and time frame for repeat procedure
For additional timing and documentation requirements, see CMM-600.1: Prior Authorization Requirements
Documentation required: Imaging findings noted in the applicable procedure section(s)
Documentation of severe debilitating pain and/or dysfunction to the point of being incapacitated (for urgent/emergent conditions meeting other criteria)
Proof of smoking cessation (for non-urgent cases)
Documentation of provider-directed non-surgical management (for non-urgent cases)
Documentation of absence of unmanaged significant mental and/or behavioral health disorders (for non-urgent cases)
